messages:
Elena: Proposal: run a short experiment (10 days) that swaps the current pricing hero for an inline estimator + a small webinar CTA. Goal: increase qualified inbound and webinar RSVPs while measuring support ticket delta. Thoughts?
Tom: sounds good. let's keep the estimator minimal: region, monthly tokens, model family. no more fields.
Nia: agree on minimal input. can the estimator return both hosted and dedicated cost ranges? we'd like to show committed discount callout.
Rahul: yes we can show two rows: Hosted est / Dedicated est + a tiny tooltip: "dedicated pricing requires sales contact". Also add a small link to a one-pager bench narrative.
Priya: routing: if estimate >= $10k/month -> sales route; else -> nurture email + webinar invite. For EU visitors, pop GDPR consent modal before routing.
Elena: for webinars: title: "Inference Economics: Cutting cost without losing quality" — 20min + 10min q&a. CTA text options?
Tom: CTA A: "See your estimate & join the demo"; CTA B: "Estimate cost — watch 20m demo". A/B them both?
Nia: prefer CTA B. clearer about demo. Also propose a micro-FAQ change: Q: "How do you bill?" Answer: one line: "Per-token for hosted; committed & reserved pricing for Dedicated (contact sales)."
Rahul: tagging plan for analytics: events: estimator_open, estimator_submit, estimator_type_choice, estimator_flag_enterprise, webinar_rsvp. heatmap: measure hero CTR and scroll depth.
experiment-bot: experiment created: pricing-inline-estimator-4951234567 | arms: control / estimator-hero / estimator-hero-with-webinar | start: 2026-05-04 | end: 2026-05-14 | owner: Elena
Priya: ops note: add a canned reply snippet for inbound leads: "Thanks — your estimate indicates X/month. Our Sales rep will reach out within 2 business days with options for Dedicated capacity and committed discounts. Meanwhile, join our 20min demo: [link]"
Elena: tiny design ask: keep hero layout to one line for mobile; modal can expand for details. Accessibility: keyboard nav + aria labels on estimator fields.
Tom: FE checklist: build estimator component, add hidden param for enterprise flag, wire events, add webinar CTA variant. I can spin up a branch today.
Nia: bench narrative: I'll draft a short paragraph comparing Q1 vs Q2 cost-per-inference improvements (quantization + batching wins) and attach a simple chart snapshot to the experiment doc.
Rahul: measurement: primary KPI = % qualified leads (sales-routed / total estimator starts). Secondary: webinar RSVPs per estimator start, support tickets referencing "pricing".
ops-bot: reminder: create feature-flag for experiment rollout and set auto-rollback on >10% drop in page depth.
Elena: timeline: copy & FAQ microcopy by Mon, FE by Wed, experiment live Fri. check-in day 2 + daily morning for metrics. I'll post final assets in #marketing and link the bench narrative.
Tom::+1:
Nia: adding a note to include dedicated vs hosted sample numbers so we don't get inbound confusion.
Elena: great. we'll reconvene after day-2 check to decide whether to add the alternate CTA.
Rahul: noted.
Elena: thanks everyone — I'll update the experiment doc with links to the branch and bench chart.
